notes.title: Release 1.2.0
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the release of [i]Time Hoppers: The Silk Road[/i] version 1.2.0!

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[b]Features:[/b]
- Added Steam Achievements!
- Doors and Levers are now highlighted when one is activated
- Added separate Music and Sound volume controls
- Added new Loading Screen images
- improve loading progress feedback

[b]Bugs:[/b]
- Fixed player stuck behind boxes in second encounter
- It is now no longer possible to not receive the Collectable Card reward after defeating a chapter boss
- We now show warnings if a previous savefile is outdated
- hide mouse cursor when gamepad is being used
- pause game with popup when controller is active and disconnected
- Game now pauses when the Steam Overlay is opened
- Improved controller navigation in level select screen
- It is now possible to purchase premium clothing with in-game coins
- fix gamepad losing selection when clicking with mouse
- fix bugs related to gamepad virtual mouse
- fix speed reset when collecting a stat upgrade while hoverboarding
